title: Tags wait until a query passes through
notes: add(2, 7, 3) changes six values but stops at two nodes, [2, 3] and [4, 7], and tags them. The values under a tag are out of date until a query passes through it: query(5, 5) pushes the tag on [4, 7] down on its way to the leaf, and [2, 3] keeps its tag.
